paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the correlation between training loss and translation quality for two different consistency objectives. The x-axis, labeled “testing k”, displays a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8, with tick labels spaced by one unit, representing different testing k values. The y-axis, labeled “Correlation”, ranges from 0.5 to 0.9, utilizing a logarithmic scale, and is marked with tick intervals of 0.05. The orange line, represented by solid circles, indicates a correlation value of approximately 0.9 at testing k = 1 and gradually decreasing to approximately 0.8 at testing k = 8. The blue line, represented by dashed circles, shows a correlation value of approximately 0.7 at testing k = 1 and steadily increasing to approximately 0.8 at testing k = 8.
